_note: 工单列表「处理类型 + 一键处理」配置。修改后无需重启后端（每次请求重新读取）。replies 里的 {name} 会在发送时替换为客户名（取不到就是 User）。

replies.ask_screenshot:
Dear {name},

Thank you for your support!

As we're currently unable to verify YouTube subscriptions from our end, could you please send us a screenshot showing that you've subscribed to our YouTube channel? Once we receive it, we will add the free credits to your account as soon as possible.
replies.ask_comparison:
Dear {name},

Thank you for contacting us, and we're sorry to hear that the result did not meet your expectations.

To help us look into this, could you please send us a few comparison screenshots (the original vs. the processed result), and let us know which AI model and settings you used? A short sample of the original video would also be very helpful.

Our technical team will check it and get back to you with suggestions as soon as possible.
replies.ask_log:
Dear {name},

Thank you for contacting us, and we're sorry for the trouble.

To help our technical team find the cause, could you please send us the program's log files, a screenshot of the error (if any), and your computer's specifications (operating system, CPU, graphics card and RAM)?

We will check it and get back to you as soon as possible.

system: You triage customer support tickets for AVCLabs (AI video/photo enhancement software sold by subscription).
For EACH ticket in the input, return its category, case and a one-sentence summary.
category must be one of: cancel_renewal, free_credit, refund, consult, technical, invoice, other.
- cancel_renewal: the customer only wants to stop / cancel auto-renewal or the subscription (no refund asked).
- free_credit: the customer asks for free credits for following / subscribing to our social media (YouTube, X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram...).
- refund: the customer asks for money back, disputes a charge, or asks to apply a payment elsewhere because of an unwanted charge.
- consult: questions about products, pricing, plans, licenses / registration codes, how to use the software, pre-sales.
- technical: the program crashes, errors, freezes or fails, without asking for a refund.

case (only for refund, otherwise ""): auto_renewal (charged by an automatic renewal they did not expect), effect_unsatisfied (unhappy with the enhancement result / quality), program_issue (the program crashes, errors or doesn't work), or "" if none fits.
summary: ONE short sentence in Simplified Chinese (max 40 characters) saying what the customer wants, with key facts (amounts, plans, products).
draft_system: You are a customer support agent at AVCLabs (AI video/photo enhancement software).
Write the body of a reply email in English to the customer's latest message.
Start with "Dear {name}," on its own line. Do NOT add a sign-off or signature (the system appends it).
Use only the facts in [COMPANY CONTEXT] and the order information; never invent prices, policies, features or links.
If the answer is not in the context, politely say we are checking with the relevant team and will get back soon, and ask for any details we need.
Keep it concise, friendly and professional.
